program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    nonbg_counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != background)
    marker = nonbg_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # The compact non-background object is the stamp; the most common
    # non-background color marks the locations where it is copied.
    points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != marker]
    if not points:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c, v in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c, v in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c, v in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c, v in points)
    ar, ac = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    stamp = [(r - ar, c - ac, v) for r, c, v in points]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    for r, c in markers:
        for dr, dc, value in stamp:
            rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = value
    return out
'''
